notes:
Context: Spectral Arc builds a hosted KB + support platform for mid-market SaaS vendors. Evaluating Redwood for RAG layer (embeddings + reranking) to replace a combo of self-hosted vector DB + third-party ranker.
- Primary ask: hosted API path only (no VPC yet) — want low ops overhead.
- Indexing: customer content + product docs + private KBs (~4M docs, ~1.1B tokens).
- QPS profile: very bursty; business-hours peak ~1k-2.5k qps for search reads, ~200-400 embedding generations/sec during spikes.
- Performance targets: p95 retrieval+rerank <150ms, p99 end-to-end <400ms for top-k responses.
- Cost target: direct cost per query (embedding+rank) target $0.002–$0.005 to be competitive with current stack.
- Model preferences: prefers open/quantized models for cost (Llama2/Redwood-verified emb models); small dedicated reranker model for fast rerank.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML + audit logs, prefer EU data residency for some customers but initial deployment NA.
- Quote from VP Eng: "If you can hit parity on latency and beat cost by 20% we'll greenlight migration for 200 accounts."
- Current tech debt: custom caching layer around embeddings, brittle rerank infra; looking to offload to Redwood Optimize suggestions.
- POC ask: run our sample index (50k doc slice) for 2 weeks; provide token-level cost breakdown and suggestions to get under $0.003/q.
- SE notes: need breakdown of batching and caching recommendations, expected batch sizes, KV cache hit-rate assumptions.
- Legal: NDA sent but legal wants data retention policy & subprocessors list before sending full dataset.
